correctness.rationale: The commuting lattice shifts permit an exact gauge propagator with site probabilities J_m²(Δ|∫_s^t exp(iz sin ωu)du|). The last-reset age is exponential at rate λ; nonreset remainder has mass exp(−λt), giving an exact periodic-in-laboratory-phase stationary site law with exponential transient. The absolutely convergent Jacobi–Anger primitive A_z separates secular J0(z)a and bounded micromotion. With ρ=λ/ω→0 and z=z*+ξρ+o(ρ) near a simple J0 zero, the fast phase of age X/ρ is asymptotically Haar and independent of Exp(1) X; bounded Bessel probabilities and discrete Scheffé give full-site total-variation convergence. Bessel identity sum m²J_m²(b)=b²/2 plus uniform-integrability yields the stated phase-dependent second moment. The L2 reverse triangle inequality shows bounded second moments iff |z−z*|=O(ρ), with outside-window divergence Δ²J0(z)²/λ². Independently evaluated the first-zero Fourier constants and phase moments by SciPy; read CHECK.py source as finite diagnostics, not proof.
